label: Framework version this portal carries

params.name: version
params.label: The framework version this copy carries (bump the minor for every change to starter/core, the major for a change a portal must act on)

params.name: date
params.label: The day this version was made (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: notes
params.default: Naming standards (tables, documents, exceptions, settings), jobs that never fail in silence, a health check that tests the store, request IDs, stronger password hashing, pinned packages.

description_nl: 2026-11-12 owner: "How in UI, I know which framework version we are working?" - core/** travels to every portal with sync_boilerplate, so this chip says which DomainTemplate version a portal was last synced from. About us shows it; CodyFy's Build setup > Framework shows the copy it sends build computers.

expect_value.notes: Naming standards (tables, documents, exceptions, settings), jobs that never fail in silence, a health check that tests the store, request IDs, stronger password hashing, pinned packages.
